scope: Project Crown SpanishNation decision review for Iberia POC

summary.balance_verdict: Conservative and suitable for observer testing.
headline_findings: The decision is available only to the intended non-Portuguese, non-Granadan Iberian culture-states.
Granada and Andalusian-to-Spain formation are deferred as intended.

The requirements are demanding but not impossible: ten key provinces across Galicia, Navarre, Catalonia, Aragon, Castile, Leon, Valencia, and Granada must be owned as cores at adm tech 10 while at peace.
The permanent claims granted on formation cover the non-Portuguese Iberia region and exclude the Portuguese/Al-Gharb areas.
Localisation exists for the Project Crown decision title and description.

notes: The vanilla diplomatic Spain path is not present in the Project Crown override.
ADU remains excluded from Spain in this POC review.
The decision preserves the normal-or-historical nation, end-game tag, subject, and former-colonial safeguards.

requirements_review.impossibility_review: No impossible requirement found. All required provinces exist in the implemented Iberian setup and can be owned and cored by an eligible tag through normal play.
requirements_review.difficulty_review: Not too easy for a POC: an eligible tag must defeat or integrate several Iberian competitors and be at adm tech 10 before forming Spain.

permanent_claim_scope.review: Claims are broad enough to consolidate non-Portuguese Spain but do not give Spain sanctioned claims on Portugal or Al-Gharb.

effect_review.modern_border_claim_review: Canaries, Ceuta, and Melilla style modern-border extras remain outside this POC; this decision grants only the current non-Portuguese Iberia-region claim layer.

observer_testing_questions: Does Spain form between the target 1550-1650 window in most hands-off runs?
Do requirements lead to a plausible 2-4 state Iberia before Spain forms?
Does excluding Portugal keep Portugal independent often enough?
Does the non-Portuguese permanent-claim scope produce reasonable post-formation cleanup without pulling Spain into Portugal by default?
intentionally_not_implemented: No rare dynastic Castile-Aragon union path.
No hostile intervention or colonial proxy-war system.
